_comment: TeX math in message bodies and canvases (DATA_MODEL.md 「本文の形式」), the same on the three clients and the server: markdown.ts tokenizeInline / parseBlocks / plainText, MessageBodyView.swift BodyTokenizer, BodyTokenizer.kt, server mentions.py notification_text (`plain` only). Inline `$…$` as Pandoc reads it: the opening `$` is followed by a non-space, the closing `$` is preceded by a non-space and not followed by a digit — nor an ASCII letter, so `$HOME and $PATH` stays text — so prices are not math. `$$…$$` within a line is math too (drawn inline, display style). `\$` is a literal dollar (outside math; inside a formula the backslash stays, it is TeX's dollar). Code spans, code blocks and URLs are never read for math; emphasis does not nest, so `**$x$**` is bold text; an unmatched `$` stays as it is. A formula is at most 2000 characters (longer: text). `inline`: tokens of one line as in inline-format.json, a formula ["math", tex] or ["math", tex, "display"] for `$$…$$`; `plain` is the one-line text of notifications, previews and search excerpts, which keep the TeX source with its dollars. `blocks`: the block kinds of a body, display math as ["math", tex]: `$$` opens a display block when it starts a line (spaces around are ignored) and a later line ends with `$$` with no blank line between (the formula is the text between, trimmed; one line `$$tex$$` is a block too); a `$$` in between, a blank line or no closing line leaves it text. Rendering (pixels) is not compared.

inline.name: Japanese directly after the closing dollar
underscores and asterisks inside a formula
backslash commands stay inside a formula
an escaped dollar inside a formula stays TeX
prices in Japanese
inline.line: 価格は$100です。予算は$200まで
tokens: 価格は$100です。予算は$200まで
inline.plain: 価格は$100です。予算は$200まで

inline.name: no math inside a code span

blocks.name: display block with text on its delimiter lines
Japanese around a display block
blocks.body:
次の式：
$$\int_0^1 x\,dx = \frac{1}{2}$$
が成り立つ

blocks.name: an unclosed display block stays text
a blank line ends the search
two display formulas on one line are inline
a display formula followed by text is inline
no display block inside a code block
a price list is not a display block
display block in a list stays inline
